name: Open Stage Island
tagline: A free, 24/7 open-air music stage in Second Life
description: Open Stage Island is a free, 24/7 open-air music venue in Second Life. Any electronic music artist can take the stage and play to a live audience — no booking, no fee. Discover freebies, attend DJ school, and meet newcomers, LGBTQI+ residents, and furries in a magical-realism setting. The stage is yours whenever you want it.
